evidence.curator_note: Generic scheme: a cyclic heteroatom (Y) OE+. radical cation, n-ionized at Y, ring-opens by alpha-cleavage of a ring C-C bond (beta to Y) to a ring-opened distonic ion (Y=CH2 oxocarbenium head, primary carbon radical tail). Instantiated with Y=O as tetrahydrofuran (oxolane) radical cation to give a parseable structure; the book draws a generic ring with a rounded bottom and the label Y, so ring size and heteroatom are not specified. Book draws 2 arcs: a small fishhook from the Y radical (+.) into the forming Y=C pi bond (move 1) and a large fishhook from the breaking ring C-C sigma bond into that same forming pi bond (move 2); move 3 (the other electron of the C-C sigma bond onto the new radical carbon) is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page but the product radical dot is shown).

Second step on the main (8.49) line, labelled 'i' (inductive/charge-site cleavage): the oxocarbenium O+-C bond of the distonic ion breaks heterolytically with both electrons migrating to the charge-bearing heteroatom, expelling neutral CH2=Y (formaldehyde for Y=O) and leaving a distonic carbenium radical cation (+CH2-CH2-CH2., m/z 42 for Y=O). Book draws 0 electron arcs for this step (only the 'i'-labelled reaction arrow); the single double-barbed arrow encoded here is curator-supplied for balance. DISCLOSED DRAWN INTERMEDIATE/PRODUCT NOT ENCODED: the figure then draws one further arrow closing this open distonic carbenium into a cyclic hydrocarbon OE+. (the half-moon 'D'-shape ring with +.); that terminal product is a delocalised radical cation with no clean localised Kekule structure (2c-1e ring bond) and its ring size/unsaturation is schematic, so it is described here but not encoded as a species.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no entry for 8.49 (nor 8.48/8.50); no MØD rule variable is cross-linked to this scheme. The generic ring-opening alpha-cleavage resembles heteroatom radical-site alpha-cleavage rules but none is indexed to this equation.
